title: Office notices, registered-agent billing, card updates and recovery

items.scope: Durably mirror every deletion decision independently of file deletion, and consult that journal even when the old file is still available. Require a trustworthy complete journal before recovery; reconcile snapshot plus later records and verify deleted documents stay unavailable. Merely checking .deleted when a file is missing fails the pending-deletion case.

Add an authenticated office resend action keyed to document ID, preserve legal-mail context and current recipient, and retain delivery status keyed to that document. Reuse the existing stored document; report send acceptance truthfully.

Acknowledge durable message receipt even when the separate office notification fails, and retain a visible retryable delivery failure for the office. Update the comment that currently promises acknowledgment only after both. Idempotency is useful if added, but no claim of exactly-once delivery is warranted.

Allow the office to record an actual resignation with a documented Terms ground, required event dates and existing chronology safeguards. Do not gate every actual resignation on a timely-cancellation schedule. Separately resolve any automatic scheduling or fee rule.

Show a charged renewal even when cancellation exists. Give an explicit current renewal/cancellation result using approved policy. Do not state cancellation guarantees another full service year irrespective of replacement or other termination events.

Schedule renewal notice attempts 70 days before renewal, retry daily, preserve the 60-day late-notice automatic-charge hold, include the fee in delayed notices, and apply the approved Terms reminder language without excusing required cancellation notice.

Derive cancellation summaries from company order records and identify the affected company; if keeping an account summary, use a clearly defined active/pending-company rule that handles a future appointment-end date.
Calculate completed counts after the final filters. Keep pending-job counts separately labeled as provisional if they are returned before completion.
Clean up only the failed staged replacement; keep the existing usable package. Prove storage, insert and order-update failures separately.

Allow authenticated clients to replace the selected company renewal card anytime, using Square STORE tokenization and CreateCard only, with consent, eligible-card checks, stable retry identity and concurrency protection; preserve the prior usable card on failure and never charge or reset the anniversary.

Purge undelivered S-election questionnaire taxpayer numbers after 90 days without a questionnaire update, preserve other answers and expose secure re-entry; preserve delivered 14-day editing cutoff and client-retained encrypted PDFs.
Keep the displayed Terms and Privacy revision dates accurate for the approved Batch28 policy changes.
Replace the frozen source-block check with failure-path and successful replacement checks while preserving the prior Batch05 fix in its archive.
Carry Adam’s approved 70-day reminder schedule into the fact ledger while preserving the 60-day hold, all prices and all other timing protections.

Reminder 60 days before renewal; cancellation notice at least 30 days before renewal; automatic charge 15 days before renewal; at least 30 days notice of a rate increase.
